current_card_text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Cannot be targeted by card effects, except your "Windborne" cards, the turn it is Synchro Summoned. If this card is Synchro Summoned using only "Windborne" monsters: You can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand, then shuffle as many cards from your hand into the Deck and if you do, during the next Standby Phase, add 1 "Windborne" card from your Deck to your hand for each card you shuffled into the Deck by this effect. During the End Phase: you can target 1 "Windborne" Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand during your next Standby Phase. You can only use each effect of "Janna, Windborne Goddess of Clement Winds" once per turn.
